description: Estimates Phi+ lab-frame fidelity, the fully entangled fraction over local unitary frames, and their fidelity gap from a physical two-qubit density matrix without acquiring data or changing hardware.

twoQubitDensityMatrix.description: Output object from ReconstructTwoQubitDensityMatrix, containing its physical rho payload in |00>, |01>, |10>, |11> order.

numericLocalUnitaryRestarts.description: Number of random numerical local-unitary initializations in addition to the identity initialization.

numericLocalUnitarySeed.description: Optional deterministic seed for the numerical local-unitary diagnostic.

entanglement.fidelity.estimate.entangled.description: Dimensionless state metrics in [0,1]: labFrameFidelity is the Phi+ overlap in the current laboratory frame; fullyEntangledFraction is the SVD maximum overlap over all maximally entangled two-qubit states, invariant under local unitaries; frameMisalignmentFidelityLoss is fullyEntangledFraction minus labFrameFidelity (clamped at zero for roundoff), ideally recoverable by local unitary compensation. targetStateDefinition fixes Phi+ = (HH + VV) / sqrt(2). crossCheck.fullyEntangledFractionNumeric and crossCheck.numericLocalUnitary contain the independent numerical optimization, without a delta field. svdLocalUnitary records method=svd and the correlation/singular-value diagnostics. No metric implies a correction applied to hardware or identifies the physical cause of a fidelity deficit. numericLocalUnitary retains only bestAttempt and attemptCount, plus unitaryA, unitaryB and rhoOptimized for that best attempt; matrices use real/imag payloads and the stated dagger transformation. Full restart histories are not exported.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.entangled.description: Path to the detailed JSON fidelity report.
Path to the compact Markdown fidelity summary.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.densityMa.description: Matching PNG/SVG pairs in labFrame and svdFrame, each with real and imaginary 4x4 density-matrix panels, a common signed color scale, and its Phi+ metric in the title. The SVD frame is a theoretical local-unitary transformation, not a hardware correction.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.fidelityC.description: Matching PNG/SVG bar chart of laboratory-frame Phi+ fidelity and the independent numerical local-unitary cross-check, on a dimensionless [0,1] axis; no hardware correction is applied.
